site_name: Land To The South Of Saw Mill Way And East Of Timberwharf Road
description: Demolition of existing buildings and erection of 5 storey (above basement) building comprising a 4-form entry nursery, and primary school (F1) for up to 720 pupils with associated facilities and landscaping
decision_conditions: <p>The application fails to demonstrate that the proposal would not have a harmful impact on the private outdoor amenity spaces for the residents at Davis Court and Leadale Road in terms of overshadowing.&nbsp; Accordingly, the proposal fails to comply with Local Plan Policy LP2.</p>

<p>The proposal is considered to have an unacceptable impact on highway safety and traffic congestion. It fails to reduce the dominance of motor vehicles both in terms of traffic congestion and managing excessive parking on surrounding streets. The proposal also fails to demonstrate how it would contribute to a safe road environment where traffic accident casualties are steadily reduced. It fails to contribute towards greening neighbourhoods by creating a cleaner, healthier environment that is able to cope with changes to the climate. Lastly, it fails to demonstrate how it would comply with TfLs Healthy Streets Indicators. It therefore fails to comply with NPPF Paragraph 115 and 116, London Plan Policy T2, and Local Plan Policy LP41, LP42 and LP45.</p><div><br></div>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-d8a6e89c-7fff-2835-8187-3e8d4f524758"><span style="font-size: 10.5pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposal has not demonstrated that the development could achieve as close to greenfield run-off rates as possible and it therefore fails to comply with London Plan Policy SI 13 and Local Plan Policy LP53. </span></span></p>
